"use client"

import type * as React from "react"
import { MinusIcon, PlusIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { cn } from "cn"
import {
  Button,
  FieldError,
  Group,
  Input,
  Label,
  NumberField as NumberFieldPrimitive,
  Text,
  type NumberFieldProps,
} from "react-aria-components"

const stepperClassName =
  "flex h-full w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground outline-none hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-50 data-[focus-visible]:ring-3 data-[focus-visible]:ring-ring/50 [&_svg]:size-3.5"

/**
 * React Aria NumberField in the aria-nova input-group look. format = formatOptions,
 * step = step, state.invalid = isInvalid / validation.
 */
function NumberField({
  className,
  label,
  description,
  errorMessage,
  placeholder,
  ...props
}: Omit<NumberFieldProps, "className"> & {
  className?: string
  label?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
  errorMessage?: string
  placeholder?: string
}) {
  return (
    <NumberFieldPrimitive data-slot="number-field" className={cn("group flex w-full flex-col gap-2", className)} {...props}>
      {label !== undefined && <Label className="text-sm leading-none font-medium select-none">{label}</Label>}
      <Group className="flex h-8 w-full min-w-0 items-center overflow-hidden rounded-lg border border-input bg-transparent transition-colors data-[disabled]:opacity-50 data-[focus-within]:border-ring data-[focus-within]:ring-3 data-[focus-within]:ring-ring/50 data-[invalid]:border-destructive data-[invalid]:ring-3 data-[invalid]:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-input/30">
        <Button slot="decrement" className={cn(stepperClassName, "border-r border-input")}>
          <MinusIcon />
        </Button>
        <Input
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className="h-full min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent px-2.5 text-center text-base tabular-nums outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground md:text-sm"
        />
        <Button slot="increment" className={cn(stepperClassName, "border-l border-input")}>
          <PlusIcon />
        </Button>
      </Group>
      {description !== undefined && <Text slot="description" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</Text>}
      <FieldError className="text-sm text-destructive">{errorMessage}</FieldError>
    </NumberFieldPrimitive>
  )
}

export { NumberField }

element.reason: React Aria NumberField with stepper buttons styled as the aria-nova Input group.
